import { CrucibleBehaviour, Subsystem } from "@trioforge/crucible";
class Janitor {}
const RunService = game.GetService("RunService");
import { Releasing, Store, Zone } from "./bases";
declare function step(): void;
declare function janitorFor(player: Player): Janitor;
class Plain { constructor() { RunService.PreSimulation.Connect(step); } }
class Direct extends Subsystem { start() { RunService.Heartbeat.Connect(step); } } // fires frame-hooks
class Through extends Zone<"A"> { start() { RunService.Stepped.Connect(step); } } // fires frame-hooks
class ThroughOnce extends Zone<"B"> { awake() { RunService.PreRender.Once(step); } } // fires frame-hooks
class Unstored extends Zone<"C"> { private c?: RBXScriptConnection; start() { this.c = RunService.Heartbeat.Connect(step); } } // fires frame-hooks
class Own extends Zone<"D"> {
	private stepping?: RBXScriptConnection;
	start() { this.stepping = RunService.Stepped.Connect(step); }
	onDestroy() { this.stepping?.Disconnect(); this.stepping = undefined; }
}
class Inherited extends Releasing<"E"> {
	start() { this.stepping = RunService.Stepped.Connect(step); }
}
class WrongField extends Releasing<"F"> {
	private other?: RBXScriptConnection;
	start() { this.other = RunService.Stepped.Connect(step); } // fires frame-hooks
}
class Scoped extends Zone<"G"> { start() { effect(() => RunService.Heartbeat.Connect(step)); RunService.BindToRenderStep("x", 1, step); } }
class Other extends CrucibleBehaviour<"H"> { open() { RunService.PreRender.Connect(step); } }
declare function effect(callback: () => void): void;
class Janitorial extends Store {
	private janitor = new Janitor(); // fires session-lifetime
	destroy() {} // fires session-lifetime
	onShutdown() {}
}
class PerPlayer extends Store { private janitor = janitorFor(undefined as never); awake() {} }
class Behaviour extends Zone<"I"> { private janitor = new Janitor(); destroy() {} }
class Loose { private janitor = new Janitor(); destroy() {} }
export { Direct, Through, ThroughOnce, Unstored, Own, Inherited, WrongField, Scoped, Other, Janitorial, PerPlayer, Behaviour, Loose, Plain };
